spawn.name: A Quiet Alley
spawn.description: The air here is thick with the smell of stale ale and wet earth. A thin, wavering haze hangs over the cobblestones, making the shadows stretch longer than they should. broken_door.name: Broken Door
broken_door.description: Skittering sounds can be heard from behind the door.

ledgerfall_market.name: Ledgerfall Market
ledgerfall_market.description: To the West you see a bustling market place.
